description: Config form spec for one network Sensor entry in devicecfg.json Sensors[]. Flattened Properties; native DTDL writable + Enum coverage; the rest is in config-rules.js. Network sensors expose Parameters.Interface (v1.0) or Parameters.Interfaces (v1.1, array or CSV string).
comment: Interface and Interfaces are mutually exclusive when both non-empty (config-rules.js rules.network). Interfaces='' / [] means auto-detect. Every network MetricName -> wire schema 'long'.

schemas.description: Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType='network'.
SensorGroup allow-list for network sensors. Conventionally 'SYS'.
Wire schema allow-list. Every network MetricName -> 'long'.
Array<string> schema referenced by the Interfaces Property. DTDL v2 requires complex schemas (Array / Object / Map) used by Properties to be declared in schemas[] rather than inline.

contents.name: Name
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty ASCII string, 1..128 chars, unique within Sensors[]. Uniqueness enforced by config-rules.js.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Name
UI hint: text input on create; read-only after.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: SensorGroup
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST be a value from the SensorGroup enum (network sensors use 'SYS').
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorGroup
UI hint: dropdown, default 'SYS'.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: MetricType
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST equal 'network' for this Interface.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Parameters.MetricType
UI hint: fixed label, not editable.
Writable: immutable -- changing it requires defining a new Sensor.

contents.name: MetricName
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST be a value from NetworkMetricName.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Parameters.MetricName
UI hint: dropdown.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: Interface
contents.description:
OPTIONAL (network-specific, v1.0 mode).
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty OS-level interface name (e.g. 'eth0'). Mutex with Interfaces (config-rules.js rules.network) -- ambiguous when both non-empty.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Parameters.Interface
UI hint: text input. Hide when Interfaces is set.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: Interfaces
contents.description:
OPTIONAL (network-specific, v1.1 mode).
VALIDATION RULE: array of non-empty OS-level interface names. Empty array means auto-detect across every interface. The wire format also accepts a CSV string ('eth0,eth1') -- normalised at parse time. Mutex with Interface (config-rules.js rules.network).
Maps to: Sensors[i].Parameters.Interfaces
UI hint: chip / tag input. Empty = auto-detect.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: Enabled
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: boolean.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Report.Enabled
UI hint: toggle / switch.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able (SIL2 maintenance lever).

contents.name: Interval
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: integer, 1 <= v <= 300000 (5 minutes). Range enforced by config-rules.js.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Report.Interval
UI hint: number input, min=1, max=300000, step=100, default=5000.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

contents.name: Description
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty string.
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorInfo.Description
UI hint: textarea or text input.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

contents.name: DisplayName
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty string.
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorInfo.DisplayName
UI hint: short text input.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

contents.name: Schema
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST equal 'long' for every network MetricName. Enforced by config-rules.js; the agent rejects startup on mismatch.
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorInfo.Schema
UI hint: dropdown, default 'long'.
Writable: immutable after creation.
